title: Spectral Pals
description: Adds some new little ghost pals that fight nearby monsters after you die! Upgrade them and watch them delete every monster in their path!
body:
# Spectral Pals

Add some new little ghostly creatures that will spawn once you die to fight nearby monsters!!

They can be upgraded from level 1 to 5 to make them even more of a flying menace!!!

Get some upgrade orbs from monsters spawners chests and use them to trigger the upgrades which are permanent and persist across every new pal.
